ios.desc:
NoteFlw is like having a personal assistant for your thoughts!

Just speak, and our AI will transcribe, organise, and summarise your voice notes in a flash.

Whether you’re jotting down meeting ideas, studying, or just having a thought bubble, NoteFlw keeps you focused - no typing required!

Record instantly with fast, high-quality voice capture.

Get clear summaries and categories automatically with AI summarization.

Find your notes by topic, keyword, or sentiment with organised insights.

Sync and keep your data secure and accessible.

Designed for thinkers, creators, students, and professionals alike.

Why NoteFlw?

Most apps just transcribe your notes. NoteFlw takes it a step further - it understands your notes, highlights key points, and helps you rediscover ideas when you need them most.

Speak it. See it. Remember it.

show_hn.title: Show HN: We built an AI note app because voice memos are chaos

quotes.text:
Voice memos are great until you try to find something later.

I built NoteFLW to fix that — it listens, summarizes, and organizes everything you say, automatically.

No more scrolling through 200 recordings of “meeting notes” and “idea from last night.”

It’s early, still rough around the edges, but surprisingly effective.
